prompt: 2-round 32-line English battle rap between Michael De Santa (slick condescending Vinewood mobster, 90s G-Funk flow) and Trevor Philips (unhinged desert outlaw, explosive Trap Metal flow). Dark comedy roasts escalating to brutal North Yankton graveyard betrayal: Rockford Hills scotch vs Sandy Shores dress/gasoline, Ron & Wade meth trailer, Johnny Klebitz, crying for Mommy, fake Witness Protection FIB rat Dave, Amanda with yoga coach Fabien, Jimmy drugging him, Tracey on Lazlow TV, Brad's coffin, Ending A vs B loyalty, Agent Trevor cancelled vs Vinewood return, GTA 6 taking the crown. Tight AABB rhymes, 10-12 syllables per bar, savage punchlines.

variants.text:
[Verse 1]
I wore that fake white collar, you wore dirt like cologne
Rockford Hills scotch in my hand, you still smell like a throne
You married gasoline, dressed up Sandy Shores grime
Ron and Wade in the trailer, that’s your whole crime line

You shot Johnny for a tantrum, then called it a plan
Crying for Mommy in the dust, still pretending you man
Dave played Witness Protection, you a F.I.B. rat suit
I made the lie look corporate, you made chaos look cute

Amanda got that yoga coach, you got left on the mat
Jimmy spiked your little temper, now you twitch and you snap
Tracey on Lazlow T.V., you just bark at the screen
Brad in that coffin below us, now tell me what loyalty means

Ending A or B, you never chose with a spine
I kept my face in Vinewood while you lost your mind
Agent Trevor got cancelled, I’m the one they let return
When the crown shifts to G.T.A. 6, you’re just ash in the burn

[Verse 2]
Look at this silk-suit parasite, talking rich with a grin
I’m the desert’s bad headline, I come loaded for sin
North Yankton cold? I like it, it keeps my rage awake
You talk clean to the cops while your whole life’s a fake

I wore a dress and lit gasoline, laughed through the smoke
You wore a tailored little mask and still died by the joke
Your Vinewood voice got manners, mine got blood in the snare
I’ll crack your teeth like bottle glass, then dance in the glare

You hide behind Dave and a pension, I hide behind blast
You say “loyalty” like a prayer, I say “survive” too fast
Brad’s coffin, your conscience, your black little vault
You buried friends for a payout and called that a default

Amanda’s coach had your soul in a pose and a pose
Jimmy turned you to poison, now your family knows
Tracey sold you to T.V., I sold truth to the flames
You’re a graveyard rumor in a suit with no shame

So pick your ending, old banker, I don’t need the crown
I’m the noise that keeps coming when your whole world shuts down
G.T.A. 6 taking crowns, yeah, but I’m still the spark
You’re a polished tombstone, I’m the bite in the dark
variants.title: North Yankton Check
tags: Battle rap, 90s G-Funk into trap-metal collision, mid-tempo swing with hard snap drums and distorted sub drops; Verse 1 rides slick West Coast pocket, Verse 2 explodes into shouted trap-metal cadence; each verse keeps tight double-tracked leads, sly ad-lib tags, and aggressive callout echoes; pre-hit risers, glassy reversed swells, record-scratch accents, and a filthy low-end mix that’s bright, punchy, and mean

variants.text:
[Verse 1]
Rockford Hills scotch, you sip mud by the tank
I toast to class, you taste diesel and tank
Your Sandy Shores dress got stained by the fling
I brought the bad luck, you brought back the sting

You scream at the sky, then you beg for your mom
I sign papers clean while your trailer goes bomb
Ron and Wade watch your whole little scam fold
Meth in the air, and your manners look old

[Verse 2]
I’m the North Yankton grin in a polished black suit
You’re the dirt on my boots and the blood in your boot
Johnny Klebitz learned how a grave gets a name
You learn the same lesson: rage don’t equal fame

You hide with Dave like a rat in a cage
Fake Witness Protection, same fraud, same stage
Amanda got Fabien while you played the clown
Jimmy drugged your crown, now your kingdom breaks down

[Verse 3]
Brad in the coffin, I’m still in the light
Your “loyalty” cracks every time that you bite
Tracey on Lazlow made your whole head spin
I watched your last hope with a grin and a gin

Ending A, you’re ashes; B’s still a snitch
Agent Trevor gets shelved, then you scratch like a hitch
Vinewood comes back when the old wolves survive
GTA 6 takes the crown while you’re barely alive

[Verse 4]
You call me a suit? I call you a stain
A loud desert accident, all teeth and no brain
You bark at the moon, get buried in sand
I bury your legend with one steady hand

North Yankton ice and the shovel still warm
You’re a headline I laugh at in a cleaner storm
So keep on exploding, that’s all that you do
I’m the last clean cut before they remember who’s who
variants.title: Rockford to Sandy
tags: Battle rap with 90s G-Funk swagger colliding with trap-metal fury; bouncing mid-tempo swing in the verses, round 1 starts sleek and condescending, then Trevor’s section detonates in jagged half-time aggression. Round 2 tightens with insult-heavy callouts, shouted doubles on punchlines, gang-style ad-libs on the nastiest bars, and sharp turntable cuts between rounds. Dry vinyl crackle, siren risers, and bass drops on key betrayals; mix is loud, glossy, and mean.
